identity.findings: Hipparchia of Maroneia，犬儒学派女哲学家，克拉特斯之妻，梅特罗克勒斯之妹，马里oneia（马罗涅亚）出身。与希帕提娅（Hypatia，亚历山大里亚，公元4—5世纪）不是同一人物：本条目为2026-10-24新建独立档案，解除旧别名错误重定向（retirement manifest 已记录 previousTarget 希帕提娅 并注明应补独立条目）。

sources.title: Diogenes Laertius：Lives of the Eminent Philosophers, Book VI（Hicks英译，维基文库录本）
sources.readScope: 本回合读入卷六文本：目录（第7节列Hipparchia）、Crates段93（Alexander/Philip一句、Eratosthenes记Pasicles生）、Metrocles段94、Hipparchia段96—98全文。未通读其余各节。

sources.title: IEP：Hipparchia of Maroneia
sources.readScope: 通读专条（阅读经结构化提取完成，覆盖导言至结论）：生年340—330推定、马里oneia、兄长Metrocles（原Lyceum学生）、爱上克拉特斯言谈与生活、脱衣相示引文、犬儒婚姻与Epictetus独身例外、anaideia、Theodorus交锋（酒神伴侣引文/教育反问/打人三段论/扒斗篷）、Cynic Epistles的athlete生产与龟壳摇篮细节、DL晚出与apt stories警示、著作尽佚、对芝诺《理想国》男女平等的影响。

checks.claim: 马里oneia出身、活跃于前300年前后、兄长原为Theophrastus学生、爱上克拉特斯言谈与生活、以死允婚、脱衣相示语。
checks.locator: §96：Hipparchia too, sister of Metrocles…captured by their doctrines. Both of them were born at Maroneia…fell in love with the discourses and the life of Crates…This is the bridegroom, here are his possessions；§94：Metrocles…pupil of Theophrastus the Peripatetic；生年推定见iep-hipparchia

checks.claim: 同装、公开生活、同赴宴饮；阿普利乌斯/奥古斯丁晚出转述；安提斯泰尼—第欧根尼不婚传统与爱比克泰德例外。
checks.locator: Cynic marriage节：later authors (Apuleius, Augustine)…infamous；earlier Cynics like Diogenes and Antisthenes held the philosopher would never marry；Epictetus later allowed exceptions…because of this marriage；§97：adopting the same dress…lived with him in public and went out to dinners（dl6-hicks）

checks.claim: 吕西马库斯宴席：酒神伴侣之讥、教育反问、打人三段论、扒斗篷、不动声色。
checks.locator: §97—98：Any action which would not be called wrong if done by Theodorus…；He had no reply…but tried to strip her of her cloak…no sign of alarm；Is this she Who quitting woof and warp and comb and loom?；instead of wasting further time upon the loom I spent it in education

checks.claim: 著作尽佚（书信、玩笑、驳论）；史料晚出传说混杂；经克拉特斯影响芝诺《理想国》男女平等。
checks.locator: sources节：DL is writing centuries later…may include 'apt' stories；No writings of Hipparchia survive (DL says she wrote letters, jokes, refutations, now lost)；influenced Zeno…whose Republic advocated sexual equality；另一手佐证dl6-hicks §98

checks.claim: 生年推定、马里oneia、兄长师承、求婚叙事。
checks.locator: §96全文；§94；生年推定见iep-hipparchia（born between 340–330 B.C.E., mid-teens）

checks.claim: 犬儒婚姻与按犬儒方式养育子女；Pasicles；书信集价值有争议。
checks.locator: Cynic marriage节与Cynic Letters节：a son, Pasicles (per Eratosthenes and Diogenes Laertius)；raised children per Cynic values；birth without trouble…like an athlete；另一手dl6-hicks §97（Eratosthenes在Crates段记Pasicles）
§97—98；These tales and countless others are told of the female philosopher

checks.claim: 犬儒婚姻、anaideia、织机与教育、改换通货四概念。
checks.locator: embodying anaideia (shamelessness)—the view that virtuous acts done in private are no less virtuous in public；performed the Cynic feat of 'changing the currency' for both her culture and the Cynic tradition；织机之答见dl6-hicks §98

checks.claim: 以DL卷六96—98为testimony条目（著作尽佚）。
克拉特斯/梅特罗克勒斯/第欧根尼/安提斯泰尼/塞奥多罗斯/芝诺（基提翁）各卡与六条关系。
checks.locator: §93—98（克拉特斯师承与犬儒谱系、Theodorus交锋、梅特罗克勒斯改宗叙事§94：haunted by…也可见IEP Metrocles节）；芝诺线索与不婚传统见iep-hipparchia

checks.claim: 两条路线与史料性质讨论（apt stories警示、传说层本身是史料、存在无可怀疑）。
